item: Project skeleton with CI Docker Flyway and a WebSocket health check
acceptance_criteria: Given a clone, when mvnw verify runs in CI, then the pipeline is green and the WebSocket health check answers a ping

item: Register with email name and role
acceptance_criteria: Given valid data, when I register as an instructor, then I can log in with that role

item: Log in with a JWT of 12 h expiry
acceptance_criteria: Given a registered user, when I log in, then a JWT is issued that is accepted for 12 h and rejected after that

item: Role checks for instructor and student pages
acceptance_criteria: Given a student session, when I open an instructor page, then I get a 403, and with an instructor session I see the page

item: Create quiz with title description and visibility
acceptance_criteria: Given an instructor, when I save a new quiz with a title and a visibility, then it appears in my quiz list with that visibility

item: Add edit reorder and delete questions
acceptance_criteria: Given a quiz with two questions, when I move the second question to first place, then the new order is saved and is the same after a reload
Given a question with three options and two correct answers, when I select both correct options, then it scores full, and when I select one, then it scores zero
